desc.zh: 焦、浓、重、淡、清,同一锭墨兑不同的水。层级靠浓淡:最要紧的一笔用焦墨,远处和背景用淡墨、清墨。写字只用焦、浓两档。
desc.en: Burnt, thick, heavy, light, clear: one ink, different amounts of water. Hierarchy comes from depth — the key stroke in burnt ink, far things in light and clear. Words only in the two darkest.

title.zh: 三种笔:提按 · 飞白 · 晕染
title.en: Three brush effects: pressure, dry brush, bleed

desc.zh: 提按:起笔斜切按下,行笔略提,收笔出锋。飞白:墨少了笔毛分开,白丝出在笔画里面,边上的毛先断。晕染:一笔落定后墨往纸里渗开。
desc.en: Pressure: a slanted press, a lighter run, a pointed exit. Dry brush: as ink runs out the hairs part and white streaks open inside the stroke, edge hairs first. Bleed: once a stroke lands, ink creeps into the paper.

title.zh: 印章:朱文 · 白文 · 盖印
title.en: Seals: red text, white text, stamping

desc.zh: 一方朱印是画面的句号。朱文是红字,白文是红底留出纸色的字;边缘蚀出残缺才像石头刻的。盖印:印落下、颜色压实。
desc.en: A red seal is the full stop of a picture. Red-text seals carve the characters; white-text seals carve the ground. A chipped edge reads as stone. Stamping: the seal lands and the colour presses in.

title.en: One mountain, four ways of colouring

desc.zh: 水墨不一定是黑白的。纯水墨只有墨和印;浅绛加淡赭石、淡花青;青绿用石青石绿,颜色重;没骨不勾墨线,颜色直接泼染。
desc.en: Ink wash need not be black and white. Pure ink: ink and a seal. Light-ochre: pale ochre and indigo. Blue-green: heavy azurite and malachite. Boneless: no ink outline, colour laid straight on.

title.en: Layers: far is pale, near is dark

desc.zh: 底层基础设施画成淡墨远山,越往上墨越浓;正在讲的那一层用焦墨粗笔,加一方朱印。层次靠墨色深浅,不靠颜色。(远山是比喻)
desc.en: Infrastructure at the bottom is a pale far ridge; each layer up is darker; the layer being explained gets burnt ink, a heavy brush and a red seal. Depth carries the hierarchy, not colour. (The far ridge is a metaphor.)

title.en: Data flow: water in a channel

desc.zh: 请求像水,沿渠走;分叉处是判断,命中缓存走上渠,没命中走下渠查库,两路在出口汇合。花青只代表「数据」一件事。(水渠是比喻)
desc.en: A request flows like water along a channel; the fork is a decision — a cache hit takes the upper channel, a miss the lower one to the database; both meet at the outlet. Indigo means one thing only: data. (The channel is a metaphor.)

title.en: A flow with a decision: sign-in

desc.zh: 判断用藤黄淡彩的菱形,是 / 否两条出口都写字;错三次锁定,用胭脂只标这一处。每个框四笔画成,线不出飞白,免得箭头断开。
desc.en: The decision is a gamboge-washed diamond with both exits labelled; three failures lock the account, and rouge marks only that. Each box is four brush strokes; lines carry no dry brush so arrows never break.

title.en: A loop: one turn of an event loop

desc.zh: 一笔圆相画出循环,四站按顺序点亮:取任务、执行、处理微任务、渲染;一滴墨沿着圆走,6 秒一圈,一直转。
desc.en: One brush circle (enso) is the loop; four stations light up in order — take a task, run it, drain microtasks, render — and an ink drop rides the circle, 6 s a turn, forever.

title.zh: 哈希表:墨点落进对应的抽屉
title.en: A hash table: each drop falls into its drawer

desc.zh: 五个字按「码点 mod 7」算出抽屉号,墨点落进去;「竹」和别的字算到同一个抽屉,挂在后面(链表)。左边高亮到哪一行,右边就落到哪一滴。
desc.en: Five characters, drawer = code point mod 7; each drop falls in. 竹 lands in a drawer already taken and hangs behind it (a chain). The lit line on the left and the falling drop on the right move together.

desc.zh: fact(4) 调 fact(3),一层套一层,每进一层画一座更小、更浓的山;到 fact(1) 见底,再一层层带着结果回来:1、2、6,最后 24。
desc.en: fact(4) calls fact(3), and so on: each call is a smaller, darker hill inside the last; at fact(1) it bottoms out and the results climb back: 1, 2, 6, and finally 24.

title.zh: 刘徽割圆术:边数翻倍逼近 π
title.en: Liu Hui: doubling the sides to close in on π

desc.zh: 圆里先画正六边形,半周长是 3;每次把边数翻一倍:12 边 3.1058,24 边 3.1326,……,192 边 3.14145。数由同一段代码算出(边长 s₂ₙ = √(2 − √(4 − sₙ²)))。
desc.en: Start with a hexagon inside the circle: half its perimeter is 3. Double the sides each time: 12 sides 3.1058, 24 sides 3.1326 … 192 sides 3.14145, computed by the same code.

title.en: Zhao Shuang's figure: the Pythagorean theorem

desc.zh: 勾 3、股 4。四个直角三角形围成边长为弦的大正方形,中间空出边长 1 的小正方形:弦² = 4 × 6 + 1 = 25,弦 = 5。
desc.en: Legs 3 and 4. Four right triangles make a big square on the hypotenuse with a small 1×1 hole: c² = 4 × 6 + 1 = 25, so c = 5.

title.zh: 梯度下降:墨滴滚进山谷
title.en: Gradient descent: an ink drop rolls into the valley

desc.zh: 从 x = -2.6 出发,每步往坡度的反方向走 0.45 倍坡度;第 17 步坡度小于 0.02,停在 x = 1.70,f = 0.886。曲线和每一步都由同一个函数算出。
desc.en: Start at x = -2.6; each step moves 0.45 × the slope downhill. After 17 steps the slope is under 0.02: x = 1.70, f = 0.886. The curve and every step come from the same function.

title.zh: 冒泡排序:竹节长短换位
title.en: Bubble sort: bamboo stalks trade places

desc.zh: 六根竹子的节数 5、2、8、1、6、3。相邻两根比一比,左边高就换;一共换了 8 次,排成 1、2、3、5、6、8。每一帧都是真跑排序记下的状态。
desc.en: Six stalks of 5, 2, 8, 1, 6, 3 joints. Compare neighbours, swap if the left one is taller: 8 swaps in all, ending 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8. Every frame is a state recorded from a real run.
